text: Artificial intelligence is quickly changing the modern workplace. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, such as sorting data or answering simple customer questions. This allows employees to focus on more creative and complex work. AI-powered productivity tools, like smart calendars and writing assistants, also help workers save time and organise their daily tasks more efficiently. Rather than replacing people, AI often supports human-AI collaboration, where employees and machines work together to achieve better results. However, these changes mean that some jobs may disappear while new ones appear. Therefore, workers need to keep learning new skills to stay successful in a rapidly evolving job market.
